intro: The Bulwark is a fortified outpost straddling the border between Tirisfal Glades and the Western Plaguelands. Maintained jointly by the Forsaken and the neutral Argent Dawn, it serves as the Horde's front line against the Scourge and the primary launching point for expeditions into the tainted east.

p: Positioned squarely on the eastern border of Tirisfal Glades, the Bulwark is the final barrier protecting the Forsaken heartland from the blighted horrors of the Western Plaguelands. Today, rough wooden palisades and heavily armed guards defend the pass against roaming undead. It represents an uneasy but necessary collaboration, where Forsaken forces coordinate alongside the Argent Dawn to recruit seasoned champions of the Horde, turning back the minions of the Lich King before they spill into Tirisfal.
